html:
SMTO-PRX-0020 — SMTO couldn't reuse the Proxmox server remembered in this conversation

GUID: ff422f87-3494-469e-8981-1f4b638a87fd
Slug: proxmox-context-invalid
Domain: PRX · Subsystem: prx

What happened

  • This conversation remembered a Proxmox server from earlier, but that remembered information is incomplete or no longer describes a Proxmox server, so SMTO won't reuse it. Your Parameter Store entry hasn't been changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In your message, type @ and choose your Proxmox Server parameter, then send the request again. Naming the server directly gives SMTO fresh, complete details instead of the remembered ones.
  2. Open Parameter Store, select that parameter, open the Value tab and select Reveal & edit value. Check that "service" still says "proxmox". SMTO only treats a parameter as a Proxmox server when it is marked as one.
  3. If it still fails, start a new conversation and mention the Proxmox parameter with @ there. A new conversation starts without the damaged remembered details.

What success looks like

  • The Agent connects to the Proxmox server you named and returns the result.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't point the request at a different server just to get past this.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The selected profile or saved Proxmox setup does not identify a valid service, user, or Gateway scope.

What this means

  • Working-context validation rejects missing/invalid service/profile/revision/username/Gateway fields, or the selected record does not identify a Proxmox service. Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.

Why this can happen

  • Working-context validation rejects missing/invalid service/profile/revision/username/Gateway fields, or the selected record does not identify a Proxmox service.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the exact profile type/revision and public Gateway identity against supported discovery.

How to fix it

  • Working Context validation (validate in agent_runtime/skills/proxmox/working_context.py) requires exactly profile_ref, profile_revision, origin, gateway, username and verify_tls with a four-field Gateway identity, and select_binding requires a server_connection record with service 'proxmox'. Re-reference the exact Proxmox @parameter through the intended Gateway so a freshly verified setup replaces the stale entry; keep the requested server and user scope and do not submit a stale profile revision.
  • Reopen the exact Proxmox profile and rediscover its context through the intended Gateway. Preserve the requested cluster/user scope.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Fresh context binds the intended server/user scope to one valid Gateway identity.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
